{{Top|leg}}
The '''Y-v-6 model sublight drive''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]].

==Description==
The Y-v-6 was manufactured by [[Suwantek Systems]] and it was used in their [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]]. While the Y-v-6 didn't make the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] go very fast, it was a very efficient and reliable system, only requiring maintenance once a year.
